tailoring.headline: Enterprise B2B Commerce Developer | Java, Spring, Headless REST APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend e-commerce developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience delivering robust B2B e-commerce architectures, headless RESTful APIs, and complex enterprise integrations for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Highly skilled in Java, Spring, microservices, data modeling, and order management (OMS). Proven track record designing resilient data pipelines between ERP, PIM, and MDM platforms, refactoring database performance, and driving agile techno-functional requirements from concept to production release.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer
cover_en.hook: Next Engineering's commitment to delivering high-impact digital commerce solutions requires deep expertise in scalable e-commerce architecture and mission-critical enterprise integrations. With over five years of professional e-commerce engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in enterprise B2B platforms, complex backend services, and scalable API ecosystems.

bullets.label: B2B E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and deployed backend modules covering product catalogs, custom pricing, order management (OMS), and account hierarchy models for global enterprise clients.

bullets.label: RESTful & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed high-throughput RESTful services and headless commerce endpoints, streamlining omni-channel customer experiences and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise System Integration
bullets.text: Engineered automated data pipelines connecting core commerce engines with ERP, PIM (Profisee), and MDM systems to ensure synchronized cross-platform data integrity.

bullets.label: Performance & Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latencies, contributed to CI/CD release cycles, and collaborated in cross-functional agile teams to translate business requirements into robust technical specifications.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 (earliest start date: 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise commerce background can deliver immediate value to Next Engineering.

tailoring.why_company: Next Engineering stands out for its engineering rigor and client-centric digital transformation projects. I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend and integration expertise to Next Engineering's high-performing technical teams, tackling complex B2B business logic and delivering resilient, scalable solutions for international clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years building enterprise B2B e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and ERP/PIM integrations, I am excited to bring my architectural rigor and backend expertise to deliver scalable commerce solutions at Next Engineering.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I saw the B2B Commerce Developer role at Next Engineering. With 5+ years building enterprise B2B platforms, REST APIs, and ERP/PIM integrations at Rockwell Automation & Shell, I'd love to connect and discuss how my backend background fits your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer position at Next Engineering. With over five years of enterprise e-commerce backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in B2B architecture, headless REST APIs, and complex ERP/PIM integrations, I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background can support your projects.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
